svg.title: Weatherglass wordmark
svg.desc: Wordmark: the weatherglass dial from the app icon (rain cloud, sun, crimson hand towards Fair), then WEATHERGLASS set in Marcellus (SIL OFL 1.1), tracked, chrome fill, over a crimson rule. Tagline in IBM Plex Sans Condensed Medium (SIL OFL 1.1). Outlined to paths, no font needed.
